packageRules.description: Keep the cf build and Workers test runtimes together, including prereleases.
Vite plugin betas are versioned by commit hash, which does not sort by release date. Follow the beta dist-tag; rollbackPrs also offers it when its hash sorts below the current one.
An offered beta whose hash sorts lower is a rollback update in Renovate; title it as an update.
Review compiler upgrades alongside the shared preset's peer requirements.
